sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 60 for 100 seconds.
Status ailment resistance value reduction effect boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces physical and magic Ability Power by 40 for 100 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 80% for 100 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies debuff removal resistance that blocks debuff removal, special debuff removal, or kismet 1 time.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 10 seconds for one time only. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 100 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 70 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Dawn for 100 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
